data.body: AC amendment (gap G5 + G8): Post-emit filter emits telemetry on every strip. When the post-emit filter drops a mutation due to quarantine overlap, it MUST write an alert_store event `bridge-alert:quarantine-suppressed:<issue_key>` (or similar) so the operator can see what was dropped. Silent strips become invisible bugs in invariant logic. Add unit test asserting the filter writes a record per stripped mutation.
